messages:
Amelia: Hey @Diego — handing off overnight oncall to you. Quick preflight checklist so you're not surprised:
- VPN: corp-vpn profile (check docs) — confirm you can reach internal APIs.
- Pager: you're on the prod-latency rotation, make sure Opsgenie subscription is active.
- Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving (see 'oncall -> preflight').
- K8s: use `kubectx oncall-prod` / `kubectl --context oncall-prod get pods -n serving`.
- Secrets: oncall-rotations SA + SecretsManager access (we use aws-sso).
- Smoke test: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/healthz`
- Escalation: infra pager +1-555-0100, or DM Nora for ACLs.
Notes: last deploy 04:30 UTC, 95th latency for model-x ~ +2% but autoscale healthy. No active incidents. I updated the handoff doc with these items. :spiral_notepad: 

Diego: Thanks — taking it. Two quick things: when I try to read the secret for the oncall token I get `AccessDenied`. Also Opsgenie shows me as not-subscribed to prod-latency.

Amelia: Hm, I granted you the `aws-secrets-read` role this morning — try reauthing with SSO: `aws sso login --profile redwood` then `aws sts get-caller-identity`. For Opsgenie, SRE-Bot should be able to tell us subscription status.

SRE-Bot: SRE-Bot: Opsgenie check for user Diego — SUBSCRIPTION STATUS: NOT_SUBSCRIBED to team `prod-latency`. Current subscribers: Amelia, Sam, Nora. To subscribe: `opsgenie-cli add-user --team prod-latency --user diego` (request will create approval ticket).

Nora: I just pushed an IAM tweak: added `secrets:GetSecretValue` to the `oncall-rotations` role for the `secrets/oncall/token` ARN. Diego, try again — may take ~30s to propagate.

Diego: Retried — `aws sts get-caller-identity` now returns my principal, and `aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id secrets/oncall/token` returned the token. :thumbsup: Opsgenie still pending though, shows a pending invite. Sam, can you approve?

Sam: Approved Diego's Opsgenie join request for prod-latency. You should receive alerts now. FYI there's a KMS rotation planned at 03:00 UTC tonight for the `redwood-secrets` key but reads won't be interrupted — only re-encrypts on rotate. If anything weird, ping me.

Diego: Got the Opsgenie alert test. Quick runbook question: where are the model cache warmup scripts referenced?

Amelia: Warmup section is under the runbook (search for 'post-deploy warmup'). Example snippet: `python tools/warmup.py --model model-x --threads 8 --token $REDWOOD_TOKEN`. If you need to flush prefix cache: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/cache/clear?prefix=model-x/prefetch`.

Nora: Also note: kube context `oncall-prod` has read-only access to logs for oncall role. If you need admin-level `kubectl exec` we need a short-lived sudo grant (requestable via the infra runbook).

Diego: Understood. Everything I tested looks green. I'll take over now and will escalate if anything shows up overnight. Thanks for the thorough handoff, Amelia.

Amelia: Thanks — appreciate it. I'll be reachable until 21:00 UTC if you need any last-minute context. Good luck and ping if anything odd shows up. :coffee:
